english: to pass (an exam); to qualify, to be accepted
notes: text: No.060 合格 — chapter title, ‘Passing’

english: to complete, to master (a course of study or discipline)
notes: text: 念の基礎は全て修めたことになります — you will have mastered all the fundamentals of Nen
text: 念の基礎は全て修めたことになります — you will have mastered all the fundamentals of Nen
text: 創意工夫をもって独自の念を構築していく — building your own unique Nen through creative ingenuity
text: 独自の念を構築していくだけです — it’s just a matter of building your own unique Nen
text: 独自の念を構築していく — building your own unique Nen

english: ‘Hatsu’; freely manipulating one’s aura at will, the culmination of Nen ability (Hunter x Hunter term)
notes: text: 「発」とはオーラを自在に操る技術 つまり念能力の集大成といえます — ‘Hatsu’ is the technique of freely manipulating aura — in other words, it can be called the culmination of Nen ability
text: 念能力の集大成といえます — it can be called the culmination of Nen ability

english: to broadly classify, to divide into rough categories
notes: text: 6つのタイプに大別されます — broadly classified into six types
text: 念能力はその人の個性と深くつながっています — Nen ability is deeply connected to a person’s individuality
text: 大自然を遊び場にして培われたもの — something cultivated by using nature itself as a playground
text: その人が生まれつき持っているオーラの性質 — the innate nature of aura a person is born with

english: Enhancement type — strengthens the function or power something already has
notes: text: 強化系 ものの持つ働きや力を強くする — Enhancement type: strengthens the function or power something has

english: Emission type — projects one’s aura outward
notes: text: 放出系 オーラを飛ばす — Emission type: sends aura flying outward

english: Transmutation type — changes the nature of one’s aura
notes: text: 変化系 オーラの性質を変える — Transmutation type: changes the nature of aura

english: Conjuration type — materializes aura into substance
notes: text: 具現化系 オーラを物質化する — Conjuration type: turns aura into physical matter

english: Manipulation type — controls matter or living things
notes: text: 操作系 物質や生物を操る — Manipulation type: controls matter or living things

english: Specialization type — a special aura unlike any other
notes: text: 特質系 他に類のない特殊なオーラ — Specialization type: a special aura with nothing else like it

english: compatibility, affinity (between two things or people)
notes: text: これが相性を示す六性図です — this is the hexagon chart showing compatibility

english: to be adjacent to, next to each other
notes: text: 隣り合うものほど相性がいい — the ones adjacent to each other have better compatibility

english: to learn, to acquire (a skill); to memorize
notes: text: 強化系の能力は覚えやすく…特質系の能力は非常に覚えにくい — Enhancement-type abilities are easy to acquire…Specialization-type abilities are extremely hard to acquire

english: a user, a wielder (of a skill or weapon)
notes: text: 隨一の使い手といえたはずです — he could have been called a foremost user
text: 彼の天性の資質は強化系に属していたはずです — his natural aptitude must have belonged to the Enhancement type
text: 天性の資質は強化系に属していたはずです — his innate qualities must have belonged to the Enhancement type
text: 会得できたのは弛まぬ努力と武才の賜物 — being able to master it was the fruit of unceasing effort and martial talent

english: a gift, a blessing; the fruit (of one’s efforts)
notes: text: 弛まぬ努力と武才の賜物 — the fruit of unceasing effort and martial talent

english: to spend, to expend (time, effort, or money)
notes: text: 能力のほぼ全てをその能力に費やしてしまった — he ended up spending almost all his ability on that one power
text: 要するに選択ミスってことだろ — in short, it’s just a case of a wrong choice, isn’t it

english: ‘Water Divination’; a Nen-type test using a glass of water and a leaf
notes: text: 水見式 心源流に伝わる選別法です — Water Divination, a selection method handed down in the Shingen school

english: a selection method, a screening method
notes: text: 心源流に伝わる選別法です — a selection method handed down in the Shingen school
text: 「発」の修行としてもこれを用います — this is also used as training for ‘Hatsu’
text: その変化によって資質を見分けます — the aptitude is distinguished by that change
text: すごい勢いで増えてる!? — it’s increasing at a tremendous rate!?

english: to increase, to grow in number/amount
notes: text: 水がすごい勢いで増えてる — the water is increasing at a tremendous rate
text: 水の量が変わるのは強化系の証 — a change in the amount of water is proof of the Enhancement type
text: 強化系の証を示しています — it shows proof of the Enhancement type
text: さあ3人とも試してみなさい — now, all three of you try it
text: 葉っぱが動いてるっす!! — the leaf is moving!!
text: 水を舐めてみて下さい — please try licking the water
text: 少し甘い…かな? — is it a little sweet?
text: 水の味が変わるのは変化系の証です — a change in the water’s taste is proof of the Transmutation type

english: to concentrate on, to devote oneself to
notes: text: この修行に専念し — devoting yourselves to this training
text: 今の変化がより顕著になるよう — so that the current change becomes more pronounced
text: 鍛練を続けなさい — continue your training
text: 戦闘日を指定するから — because I’ll specify the day of battle
text: 天空闘技場で戦ろう! — let’s fight at Heaven’s Arena!
text: やあ待ってたよ — hey, I’ve been waiting
text: ボクといつ戦うか決めたかい? — have you decided when you’ll fight me?
text: 楽しみにしているよ — I’m looking forward to it
text: 修行の成果を見せてもらいましょうか — shall I have you show me the fruits of your training?
text: 次 キルア君 — next, Killua
text: よろしい — very well
text: ハチミツみたいだよ!! — it’s like honey!!
text: たいしたものです — that’s quite impressive
text: 2人とも今日で卒業です — both of you graduate today
text: 念法の会得はハンターになるための最低条件 — mastering Nen is the bare minimum requirement to become a Hunter
text: プロのハンターには相応の強さが求められる — a professional Hunter is required to have commensurate strength
text: 悪用されれば恐ろしい破壊力となる — if misused, it becomes a terrifying destructive power
text: 悪用されれば恐ろしい破壊力となる — if misused, it becomes a terrifying destructive power
text: 恐ろしい破壊力となるこの能力 — this ability that becomes a terrifying destructive power
text: 犯罪抑止力としての強さがどうしても必要となる — strength as a deterrent to crime is absolutely necessary
text: 邪な密猟者や犯罪者を捕えること — capturing wicked poachers and criminals
text: 犯罪者を捕えることはハンターの基本活動 — capturing criminals is a basic Hunter activity

english: no matter what, by all means
notes: text: 強さがどうしても必要となる — the strength is absolutely necessary no matter what
text: ぜひもう一度試験を受けて下さい — please, take the exam one more time

english: to feel inclined, to feel like (doing something)
notes: text: 気が向いたらね — if you feel like it
text: 師範代の2人のことは色々聞きました — I’ve heard a lot about the two assistant instructors
text: 私が保証します — I guarantee it
text: 今の君には十分資格がありますよ — you currently have more than enough qualification

english: to do one’s best, to persevere
notes: text: みんな頑張ってるんだね — everyone’s really working hard
text: イルミとヒソカは初めから条件を満たしてます — Illumi and Hisoka have fulfilled the conditions from the very start

english: to have a hard time with, to be stumped by
notes: text: 「練」の習得にかなり手こずってるよう — seems to be having quite a hard time mastering ‘Ren’
text: 「練」の習得にかなり手こずってるよう — having a hard time mastering the acquisition of ‘Ren’
text: 最後に一つ忠告です — one last piece of advice

english: earnestly; (with a negative) whatever you do, be sure not to…
notes: text: くれぐれもムリをしないように!! — whatever you do, don’t overexert yourself!!
text: 明日の試合くれぐれもムリをしないように — for tomorrow’s match, whatever you do don’t overexert yourself
text: 自信を持ちなさい — have confidence
text: あなたの上達の早さは並じゃない — the speed of your improvement is no ordinary thing
text: 上達の早さは並じゃない — the speed of your improvement is no ordinary thing
text: いつか絶対追いついてみせるっス! — someday I’ll definitely catch up!
text: そして決戦当日 — and then, the day of the decisive battle
text: グラスにたっぷりと水を入れて — fill a glass generously with water

english: to float something, to set something afloat
notes: text: 葉っぱを浮かべ「練」を行う — float a leaf and perform ‘Ren’
text: 水に不純物が出現→具現化系 — impurities appear in the water → Conjuration type
text: 水に不純物が出現 — impurities appear in the water
